methodology.baseline: Actual target source files loaded with git show from baselineCommit; no hand-reimplemented baseline.
methodology.isolation: All non-target dependencies resolve to candidateCommit. Baseline Vehicle imports the actual baseline RoadContactFrame; all other dependencies are shared. Both contact constructors use the identical candidate BVH and authored track data. Unrelated engine changes cannot explain the A/B difference.
methodology.frameAndClutch: Actual baseline RoadContactFrame and Vehicle modules, with shared candidate dependencies. Baseline Vehicle imports baseline RoadContactFrame directly; no per-instance method patch is present during timing.
methodology.timing: Sequential exclusive workers. Ten paired samples alternate baseline/candidate order, with five pairs of each order. Warmup precedes samples; explicit GC precedes each timed sample. Instrumentation, serialization, track/vehicle setup, comparison and GC are outside the timer.
methodology.heap: One contact mesh/tree at a time. Baseline geometry is written to temporary binary files before the candidate is built and compared byte for byte. Each child has a 768 MiB old-space limit.
methodology.counts: Instrumented proof workers count typed-array set calls with literal-array operands, Math.hypot calls and tire-array map calls. These semantic operation counts are distinct from physical allocator/GC counts.
methodology.catalogue: No authored AWD definition enables engine.clutchCoupling at this revision. AWD microbenchmarks call the real method explicitly on real AWD Vehicle instances; this is dormant-branch evidence, not an active-catalogue runtime saving.
methodology.limits: Node CPU evidence only. No renderer, browser, GPU, full-game FPS, physical-device or cross-machine claim. A controlled constructor includes the unchanged shared BVH cost. Hot-loop timings include identical input writes and checksum work.

frame.description: Actual set calls over 128 prebuilt pitch/roll/bank/steer/camber frames; checksum accumulation included.

clutch.description: Explicit dormant AWD method on a real rl2 Vehicle; four slip writes, four load writes and checksum accumulation per call. No authored coupling change.

substeps.fixture: Unmodified DynamicsTrack analytic runway with deterministic support loss; real catalogue definitions, no explicit AWD coupling.
